articles.summary: BioTools Innovator (BTI) VANGUARD, a joint initiative between BTI and the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA), has awarded CellChorus a $200,000 non-dilutive funding contract to support development of AI-enabled pathogen-immune profiling using TIMING single-cell assays.
articles.title: BioTools Innovator VANGUARD awards CellChorus contract to support AI-enabled pathogen-immune profiling
